description: This file defines the EmployeeEventDao class, responsible for managing EmployeeEvent entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving employee events and retrieving employee events based on search filters such as date range, employee number, event type, and event description. It interacts with the database via query builders and utilizes pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeEventDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmployeeEvent entities, providing methods to save and retrieve employee events with various filtering options.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeEvent entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmployeeEvent entities based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginated query for EmployeeEvent entities based on search filter parameters, including optional date range and other criteria.
